manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. A second ball is released at that moment to fall together.
manifest.description: Two side-by-side vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball. Velocity and acceleration vectors accompany each ball, updated in real time.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
